ideas.name: Large-Coin Weekly High Momentum
ideas.claim: Among large, liquid cryptocurrencies, the previous week's closing price relative to its weekly high predicts the following week's cross-sectional returns.
ideas.quote: The 1-week high-momentum predicts positively future returns of large and liquid coins (NW t-stat = 4.93) and negatively the returns of small and illiquid coins (NW t-stat = -9.03).

rules.entry: Rank eligible coins by the logarithm of the week-end close divided by the preceding week's highest intraday price; go long the highest quintile and short the lowest quintile.
rules.exit: Measure the portfolio return over the following week and rebalance weekly.
rules.filters: Market capitalization at least USD 50 million; previous-week dollar trading volume at least USD 5 million; week-end price at least USD 0.001.

ideas.claimed_result: For the large and liquid group, the one-week high-momentum long-short effect has a Newey-West t-statistic of 4.93 over June 2017 to December 2022.

ideas.name: Three-Week Cross-Sectional Momentum
ideas.claim: Cryptocurrencies ranked by their preceding three-week returns show differences in subsequent weekly returns.
ideas.quote: Each week, we sort individual cryptocurrencies into quintile portfolios based on the value of a given factor.

rules.timeframe: Three-week ranking; weekly holding and rebalancing
rules.entry: Rank coins by the preceding three-week return; go long the highest quintile and short the lowest quintile, using value-weighted portfolios.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports an average weekly long-short return of 4.1% for the three-week momentum sort over 2014–2018.
